vsFreeletics.title: VISOR vs Freeletics: Adaptive AI vs Bodyweight Workouts
vsFreeletics.description: Freeletics adjusts bodyweight programs with AI. VISOR adds visual body transformation previews, an emotionally adaptive coach, and Soul Track identity streaks.
vsFreeletics.intro: Freeletics pioneered AI-adjusted bodyweight training. VISOR builds on that foundation with visual transformation previews, emotional adaptivity, and identity-driven streaks.

sections.heading: Core difference
sections.body: Freeletics optimizes the *workout*. VISOR optimizes the *person doing the workout* — what they see, how they feel, who they're becoming.

sections.heading: Feature comparison
sections.body:
- **Bodyweight programming:** Freeletics — its strength. VISOR — included, plus weighted and gym programming.
- **AI program adaptation:** Freeletics — adjusts difficulty per session. VISOR — adjusts difficulty *and* coaching tone to mood.
- **Visual body transformation:** Freeletics — none. VISOR — AI previews at Month 1, Month 3, Olympia mode.
- **Emotional intelligence:** Freeletics — fixed coach voice. VISOR — supportive, challenging, or recovery personalities.
- **Identity gamification:** Freeletics — workout streaks. VISOR — Soul Track ties streaks to identity, not just sessions.
- **Nutrition:** Both included.
- **Human coaching:** Freeletics — none. VISOR — Elite tier.

sections.heading: When Freeletics wins
sections.body: You want a focused bodyweight HIIT system, you train alone, and a single coach voice works for you. Freeletics is mature and proven for that.

sections.heading: When VISOR wins
sections.body: You need to *see* the outcome to commit, your motivation fluctuates, and you want training that adapts to the person — not just the protocol.

vsMyFitnessPal.title: VISOR vs MyFitnessPal: AI Body Transformation vs Calories
vsMyFitnessPal.description: MyFitnessPal logs calories. VISOR predicts your future body, coaches you emotionally, and gamifies identity through Soul Track. Honest comparison.
vsMyFitnessPal.intro: MyFitnessPal is the default calorie tracker for over 200M users. VISOR is a newer category: identity-driven AI fitness. Both can live on your phone — they answer different questions.

sections.heading: Core difference in one sentence
sections.body: MyFitnessPal answers *"what did I eat?"*. VISOR answers *"who am I becoming, and how does today move me there?"*

sections.heading: Feature-by-feature
sections.body:
- **Calorie & macro tracking:** MyFitnessPal — extensive food database. VISOR — included, AI-personalized.
- **AI body transformation previews:** MyFitnessPal — none. VISOR — Month 1, Month 3, Olympia mode.
- **Emotionally adaptive AI coach:** MyFitnessPal — none. VISOR — adjusts tone, intensity, and personality to your mood.
- **Identity / streak gamification:** MyFitnessPal — basic streaks. VISOR — Soul Track ties streaks to who you want to become.
- **Workout programming:** MyFitnessPal — limited. VISOR — full personalized plans.
- **Human coaching:** MyFitnessPal — none. VISOR — Elite tier.

sections.heading: When MyFitnessPal is the right choice
sections.body: You already know your routine, you already train consistently, and you only need a fast database to log meals. MyFitnessPal is the proven, free-tier-friendly logger for that job.

sections.heading: When VISOR is the right choice
sections.body: You don't quit because you lack workouts — you quit because you can't see your future self. VISOR is built for the consistency problem: visualize the result, adapt to how you feel, build the identity behind the body.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: MyFitnessPal: free with Premium at ~$19.99/mo. VISOR: free tier, Core at $9.99/mo, Elite at $19.99/mo with personal coaching.

vsNoom.title: VISOR vs Noom: Identity-Driven AI vs CBT Weight Loss
vsNoom.description: Noom uses CBT-style behavior change for weight loss. VISOR uses AI body transformation previews, an emotionally adaptive coach, and identity streaks.
vsNoom.intro: Noom built a category around psychology-led weight loss. VISOR shares the conviction that behavior matters more than calories, but takes an identity-first, AI-native approach.

sections.heading: Core difference
sections.body: Noom teaches you *why* you eat what you eat. VISOR shows you *who* you're becoming and adapts every interaction to that identity.

sections.heading: Feature comparison
sections.body:
- **Behavior change model:** Noom — CBT-style daily lessons. VISOR — identity-based via Soul Track.
- **AI body transformation:** Noom — none. VISOR — Month 1, Month 3, Olympia previews.
- **Coaching:** Noom — human coaches via chat. VISOR — emotionally adaptive AI coach + optional human coaching on Elite.
- **Workout programming:** Noom — light. VISOR — full personalized plans.
- **Color-coded food system:** Noom's signature feature. VISOR uses standard macro tracking.
- **Pricing:** Noom — ~$70/mo. VISOR — Free / $9.99 / $19.99.

sections.heading: When Noom wins
sections.body: You want daily reading-based behavior lessons and a human coach as your primary contact, and the higher price isn't a blocker.

sections.heading: When VISOR wins
sections.body: You want visual proof of your trajectory, an AI coach available 24/7 that adapts to mood, and a fitness layer Noom doesn't deliver — at a fraction of the price.

aiBodyTransformation.title: AI Body Transformation, Explained
aiBodyTransformation.description: AI body transformation generates visual previews of your future body at Month 1, Month 3, and Olympia mode. The science of seeing the result before earning it.
aiBodyTransformation.intro: The most powerful predictor of behavior change isn't willpower — it's a vivid, believable picture of the person you're becoming. AI body transformation makes that picture visible.

sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: AI body transformation is the use of generative AI models to produce a realistic visual progression of a user's future physique, calibrated to their starting photo, training plan, nutrition, and timeline.

sections.heading: VISOR's three horizons
sections.body:
- **Month 1:** early visible adaptations — leaner face, posture, baseline composition shift.
- **Month 3:** the inflection point — when consistent training becomes externally obvious.
- **Olympia mode:** aspirational ceiling — the maximal version of you given the protocol.

sections.heading: Why visual prediction works
sections.body: Identity precedes behavior. When the brain accepts an image as plausibly future-self, daily decisions reorganize around it. Soul Track turns that anticipation into a streak loop, so each session is reinforcement of an identity already forming.

behaviorDrivenFitness.title: Behavior-Driven Fitness, Explained
behaviorDrivenFitness.description: Behavior-driven fitness optimizes for identity-aligned daily behavior, not workout completion. How Soul Track turns consistency into a compound asset.
behaviorDrivenFitness.intro: Workouts are a lagging indicator. The leading indicator is the identity-aligned behavior that produced them. Behavior-driven fitness inverts the priority.

sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: Behavior-driven fitness is a model that measures, rewards, and adapts to the daily behaviors tied to who a user is becoming — sleep, intentional movement, nutrition consistency, recovery — rather than counting workouts in isolation.

sections.heading: Why workout-counting fails
sections.body: "30 sessions completed" is meaningless if the underlying identity didn't shift. Most users churn the moment a streak breaks because the streak was the goal, not the person behind it. Behavior-driven systems survive missed days because the identity is intact.

sections.heading: How Soul Track applies it
sections.body:
- **Identity prompts** defined at onboarding — who you want to become, in your words.
- **Daily aligned behaviors** tracked as evidence of the identity, not as tasks.
- **Streak forgiveness** tied to identity rather than perfect execution.
- **AI Coach reinforcement** framed in second-person identity language ("you are someone who…").

emotionallyAdaptiveCoaching.title: Emotionally Adaptive Coaching, Explained
emotionallyAdaptiveCoaching.description: Emotionally adaptive coaching detects mood, motivation, and context, then adjusts tone, intensity, and personality in real time. How VISOR implements it.
emotionallyAdaptiveCoaching.intro: Most fitness coaching is fixed: same voice, same intensity, same plan whether you slept four hours or feel unstoppable. Emotionally adaptive coaching changes that.

sections.heading: Definition
sections.body: Emotionally adaptive coaching is a system that detects a user's emotional and motivational state — through check-ins, behavior signals, and context — then dynamically adjusts coaching tone, language, intensity, and program structure to match.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Adherence is the only metric that compounds. A program you abandon at week 3 returns nothing. Emotionally adaptive coaching reduces dropout by meeting you where you are: harder when you're hungry for it, gentler when you're fragile, focused on recovery when your body needs it.

sections.heading: How VISOR implements it
sections.body:
- **Mood and motivation detection** via short daily check-ins and behavioral signals.
- **Three coach personalities:** supportive, challenging, recovery-focused.
- **Real-time adjustment** of program intensity, language style, and reward framing.
- **Soul Track integration** so emotional state feeds identity progress, not just workout logs.

support.description: Get help with VISOR. Contact support, find answers to common questions, manage your subscription, delete your account, and report issues.
support.introLead: Need help with VISOR? We're here for you. Browse the common topics below or reach out directly and we'll get back to you as quickly as possible.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.lead: The fastest way to get support is by email. We typically respond within 1–2 business days.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I restore my subscription or purchase?
faq.a1: Open VISOR, go to your account or subscription settings, and tap "Restore Purchases." Make sure you're signed in with the same Apple ID or Google Play account used for the original purchase. If the issue persists, email us with your receipt or order ID.
faq.q2: How do I cancel, refund, or change my subscription?
faq.a2: Subscriptions are managed by Apple (iOS) or Google (Android). To cancel or request a refund, visit your platform's subscription settings. If you need help identifying your plan or have a billing question, contact us at [support@visorfitness.com](mailto:support@visorfitness.com).
faq.q3: How do I delete my account and data?
faq.a3: You can delete your account directly in the VISOR app from your account settings. This removes your profile, fitness data, photos and community content from active systems. If you can't access the app, email [privacy@visorfitness.com](mailto:privacy@visorfitness.com) from the email address associated with your account.
faq.q4: The app is crashing or not loading. What should I do?
faq.a4: Try these steps first: force-close the app, restart your device, and make sure you're on the latest app version and OS update. If the problem continues, email [support@visorfitness.com](mailto:support@visorfitness.com) with your device model, OS version, and a description of what happens.

billing.heading: Billing & Subscriptions
billing.body:
VISOR subscriptions are processed through Apple App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android). We do not store your payment card information.

- To cancel or manage an iOS subscription: iPhone Settings → [Your Name] → Subscriptions → VISOR.
- To manage an Android subscription: Google Play Store → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions.
- For refund requests, use Apple's or Google's refund flow, or contact us with your order details.

If you see an unexpected charge or have trouble restoring a purchase, email [support@visorfitness.com](mailto:support@visorfitness.com) and include your platform, order ID, and a screenshot if possible.

report.heading: Report a Problem or Safety Concern
report.body:
If you encounter harmful, inaccurate, or inappropriate AI output, community content, or app behavior, please report it in-app where available, or email us directly.

- General issues & feedback: [support@visorfitness.com](mailto:support@visorfitness.com)
- Privacy, data, or account deletion: [privacy@visorfitness.com](mailto:privacy@visorfitness.com)

We review reports as soon as possible and aim to respond within 5 business days for safety or abuse reports.
